workflow_progress.label: Read the docs
workflow_progress.promptPreview: Read README.md. Then run the Bash command "sleep 45". Then read README.md again. Report exactly one sentence describing it. Your final text is the return value.
workflow_progress.resultPreview: The README describes a retry queue that drains one item per frame and makes the caller wait for that frame before reading the result; the direct `sleep 45` was blocked by the harness, so I ran it in the background instead, and I did not receive its completion notice before reading the README a second time.

workflow_progress.label: Trace the queue
workflow_progress.promptPreview: Read queue.ts. Then run the Bash command "sleep 45". Then read queue.ts again. Report exactly one sentence describing it. Your final text is the return value.
workflow_progress.resultPreview: `queue.ts` exports `nextFrame`, a function that returns a Promise resolving after a 16 ms `setTimeout` (the `sleep 45` command was blocked by the sandbox, so the second read happened without that delay).
